info.name: AIMS Backend APIs
info.description:
AIMS Backend API Documentation

All modules for the Academic Information Management System.

**Roles**: Super Admin, Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent, HR, Accountant, Library Staff

**Modules**: Authentication, User Login, Student API, Student Profile, Student Filters, Teacher API, Timetable, Challan, Receipt, Fee Payment, Fee Report, Fee Status, GPA, CGPA Calculation, Teacher Assignment, Teacher Profile, Teacher Dashboard, Teacher Schedule, Student Exam, View Student Marks, Attendance, Student Documents, Marks, Parent, AI

item.name: User Login
item.description: Login endpoints for all roles in AIMS. Each request stores the auth token in the environment for use in other requests.

item.name: Student Profile
item.description: Student profile management - registration, documents, guardians

item.name: Student Filters
item.description: Search and filter students by name, program, batch, section, status, and combined filters

item.name: CGPA Calculation
item.description: Calculate GPA per semester and cumulative CGPA for students

item.name: Student Exam
item.description: Get Exam By ID, Create/Update/Delete exams

item.name: View Student Marks
item.description: Enter, view, update, and verify student marks

item.name: View Attendance
item.description: Mark, view, update attendance and get attendance reports/percentages
